verdict.rule: proceeds only if a separable set of pregame-lined (spread or total, with a pregame observed_at) events exists outside the reference events and predates the earliest reference event
verdict.same_season_pool_note: Outside-reference pregame-lined events all start on or after the reference's earliest event, so they are same-season, interleaved with the reference (no walk-forward separation). Polymarket ones are ladders (many alternate rungs, no single line) from 2026-09-04; many are FBS-vs-FCS games with no result in the history files (the known FCS gap), so only the 'with_result_in_history' subset is scorable without a backfill (name-matched, so approximate). Postgame/reconstructed prices are excluded from every count.
verdict.unblock: Pregame spread and total quotes WITH a per-quote observed_at (or an archived pre-kickoff snapshot with fetch time) for NCAAF games of the 2016-2025 seasons, keyed by (start, home, away) or ESPN event_id so they join data/historical/ncaaf_games_all.jsonl (7,965 results, 2016-2026, no lines). Needed volume: enough events before 2026-08-29 to fit and validate the residual on data that is not the reference set. A single consensus line per event (opening and closing, with times) is sufficient; Polymarket ladders only exist from 2026-09-04. Postgame or reconstructed prices stay diagnostic only (docs/AGENTS.md); data/experiments/cfb_research_experiment_spec.json's 'market_seasons 2020-2024' is an aggregate claim with no rows behind it.

Claims 4,510 lined games over market_seasons 2020-2024. Generator traced: scripts/cfb_research_pipeline.py loads data/historical/ncaaf_games_all.jsonl, which has no line fields, and evaluates every game with g.get('spread_home_line', 0.0), g.get('total_line', 54.0), g.get('market_ml_home_prob') or 0.50 and a fixed 0.5238 ask (spread/total paths at lines ~274-317, 'eligible_games' = every 2020+ game). So the 4,510 'lined' games carry defaulted constants, not quotes: synthetic, not data. The 2026-08-30 quarantine archive is likewise 'synthetic main'.

pricing_note: Percentages and lines only; American-odds fields are reported as present, never printed.
